newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AGAINST HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED AGAINST HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Thursday mixed against hard currencies after a dull interbank session, dealers said.

"The market was on the longish side and the Zimbabwe dollar seems to have stabilised against the U.S. dollar. We can now only talk of what's happening overseas, the local market is very quiet at the moment," a dealer said.
The dealers re-iterated that a three-week-old strike by junior doctors and nurses to press for better salaries and working conditions had not had any impact on the foreign exchange market.
At Thursday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was steady at 10.6400/6600 against the U.S. dollar for the fourth day running and was little changed at 7.0600/0800 from 7.0600/0770 versus the German mark.

It was firmer on the rand at 2.2600/2800 compared to 2.2740/2810 but weakened against pound sterling to 17.7100/7300 from 17.5790/6200, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas. -- Stella Mapenzauswa, Harare Newsroom: +263-4 72 52 28/9
